lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits; one primary column features four roughly equidistant maxima, with adjacent columns following a similar grid-like vertical alignment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, forming a series of anchor nodes within the grid pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on its dorsal edge to shadow on its ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) visible beneath the ventral surface and near the pectoral fin silhouette.
